problem_type: An extracted preview boundary drops hover intent and substitutes selection for automatic-preview demand
symptom: CI structural hover positive controls fail with 32 correct posters, zero mounted videos and no first/repeated playback. Source inspection proves an independent disconnected hover channel at e102.
direct_cause: Base records videoPreview.requested and binds article pointer handlers but never passes requested into GenerationNodePreviewBody. That body passes selected as both NodeVideoPlaybackGuard.previewRequested and engaged.
class_root: Distinct interaction intents must survive component extraction as explicit required props. Selection/engagement cannot silently substitute for pointer-hover preview intent at the mounting owner.
affected_population: Unselected video-result cards with measured dimensions and a poster, across read-only/editable canvases
Selected video-result cards whose selected state should mount controls without pretending a hover
Initial hover, pointer leave and repeated hover through the same shell/body path
entry_points: useNodeVideoPreviewIntent -> Base article pointer handlers -> GenerationNodePreviewBody -> NodeVideoPlaybackGuard
internal_only_reason: This is a directly observable internal React prop-wiring defect. Existing hook, callers, guard mount conditions and CI evidence establish the missing channel without assumptions about browser autoplay, permissions, media decoding or framework performance.
invariants: Hover requested and selected/engaged stay distinct across the shell/body boundary
A required boolean prop connects the existing hover owner to the existing guard; no duplicated hover state or second player
Idle poster-only behavior, original structural counts and all four playback positive controls remain unchanged
Guard dwell/grace/drag/focus/user-playback policy, deferred/resident and one-video ownership are not altered
No mutation of node, result URL/poster/measurement metadata; no outbound/permission/Provider changes
Preserve renderKind and whiteboard/audio functional protections

door_reduction.why_not: The intent hook, shell, preview body and mount guard have separate existing responsibilities. Preserve those lifecycles and connect the missing typed prop rather than merge owners or add a second player.

generality_proof: Node-only regression directly executes the real GenerationNodePreviewBody for all four hover/selection combinations in read-only and editable modes, inspects the actual returned Guard element, checks node identity and existing metadata callback, and retains non-video behavior. A TypeScript AST test checks the actual shell hook, article pointer handlers and requested prop expression. These tests prove source intent delivery only; they do not synthesize or claim browser playing/decoding success.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Pass the existing full-card pointer intent into the preview boundary
Require and forward hover intent separately from selection to the existing mount guard

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The hook already records pointer enter/leave correctly but its requested value was dropped. The actual JSX call site is structurally tested.
The real formatter is executed with frozen synthetic nodes; the returned existing Guard gets independent previewRequested/engaged props.
Poster/measured unselected cards require a delivered intent to mount; pointerInside only controls native-control visibility. Guard timing, focus, active playback and drag behavior remain unchanged.

recurrence.reason: Every unselected measured/postered video card can lose hover mounting through this shared boundary, regardless of the media URL or provider. Repeated hover cannot repair a permanently disconnected prop.
same_class_scan: Read the exact CI counters and unchanged structural hover/positive-control implementation
Generated direct hook/body/guard doors and followed the hook -> shell -> body -> guard -> deferred media chain
Checked both hover and selection inputs and read-only/editable modes
Read all production callers; one real shell call and one guard use cover the extracted boundary
Verified e102 retains functional whiteboard/audio resolver protection; no resolver edit in this patch

prevention.invariant: The preview body must receive a required hover boolean distinct from selection and pass it to the sole mounting owner.
prevention.failure_mode: A dropped prop becomes a type error; executable real-body and actual-callsite structural regressions reject substitution with selected.
prevention.strategy: Add one mandatory prop and connect two existing boundaries; remove the selected-for-hover substitution without changing mounting/playback policy.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the misleading selected-as-hover forwarding. Keep selection for engaged mount and every existing public media/control path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse existing React, TypeScript AST and Vitest APIs. No browser runtime, media engine, dependency or policy change.

migration: None. Only an in-memory interaction prop is added; persistent project/node/media data is unchanged.
residual_risks: No App/browser/screenshot/Provider/full suite is run while coordination is performing 315 screenshot checks

Actual pointer hit/occlusion, lingering drag state, autoplay permissions, media/network health and all four original CI positive controls remain unverified until coordination runs the unchanged structural scenario serially
This source defect explains zero mount under a valid hover but does not prove it is the only runtime cause in the truncated CI log
Node tests inspect actual React elements and the real callsite AST only; they do not mount or decode media and never fabricate played/replayed counters
